subject.title: Normal tool text outputs can degrade to “(see attached image)” placeholders in agent context

question: Which open implementation path should own the remaining model-visible tool-result placeholder cluster before this issue can close?
rationale: Current main is partially fixed, but open PRs cover different remaining branches and deciding the closure boundary requires maintainer intent rather than a new autonomous fix PR.

options.title: Keep This Issue As Cluster Tracker
options.body: Use this issue to track the remaining cluster while reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795, then close with merged proof.

options.title: Redirect To Later Canonical Issue
options.body: Move the remaining broad tracking to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99241 and close this issue only after linking the preserved evidence there.

options.title: Split By Fix Path
options.body: Track aggregate-projection, provider fallback, and payload-less media cases separately, keeping this issue open only for the original aggregate/provider symptom.
